topic: Analyzing session duration discrepancies in analytics
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on discrepancies found when calculating average session durations. The initial formulas used were compared, specifically regarding the inclusion criteria for `is_calibrated=1` and filtering by signal level (`signal_level<=89`) and vendor IDs. It was noted that the raw `session_duration` field is included in calculations but has a potentially large range.

Later, specific parameters related to session length were reviewed: opening hours start/end, duration start/end, signal limit (set at 89), and a maximum session length of 7200 seconds (two hours).
decisions: The maximum session duration is limited to 7200 seconds (two hours).
